unit.why: A single anecdote about R. Y.A. (a hasid of the Seer of Lublin) ransoming two Jewish girls from a Polish nobleman, raising them and marrying them off.

stories.start_quote: פעם א׳ נסע דרך בית מלוכו אדון
stories.end_quote: והשיא אותם ופזר עליהם ממון רב
stories.summary_en: A Polish nobleman passing through takes two little Jewish girls as lifelong servants for their father's unpaid debt. R. Y.A. takes pity on them, ransoms them at great cost, raises them as his own children with his wife, and later marries them off at great expense.
